'''Bakuush''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who had a [[Bakuush's palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Chemilizard" /> Bakuush founded the industrial town of [[Jiguuna]] on Nal Hutta, and the [[City/Legends|city]] became a thriving town that served as an operational hub for the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] and [[Factory/Legends|factories]] nearby.<ref name="Jiguuna" /> At the age of one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Bakuush was honored in a [[Bakuush's centennial feast|centennial feast]] in the Hutt's palace. [[Orpali dragon]]s were on the menu for the feast when several dragon hatchlings escaped into the palace's sewers, and over [[Time/Legends|time]], those hatchlings evolved into the creatures known as [[chemilizard]]s as they adapted to Nal Hutta's toxic [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="Chemilizard" /> Under Bakuush's rule, Jiguuna was a booming and influential town, but when Bakuush [[Death/Legends|died]] in a mechanical accident two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the town was enveloped in gang wars and anarchy.<ref name="Jiguuna" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakuush was mentioned in the Codex entries for chemilizard<ref name="Chemilizard" /> and Jiguuna in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Jiguuna" /> a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Jiguuna" />
